requirements.normative_proposition: For WL1 through WL3, attainable is the highest level n not exceeding both the registered boundary base and the claim for which n's conditional-required fields are present; only a Core-00 evidence lift whose requirements are met can make WL4 or WL5 attainable.
requirements.source_locator: XML anchors honesty-boundary and iana-boundary-types; base execution level, combined invariant, and Table 5

dependencies: signature fact used to establish effective_cc
requirements.normative_proposition: verified_level cannot exceed maxCapability(effective_cc): CC0 and CC1 map to WL0, CC2 to WL2, CC3 to WL3, CC4 to WL4, and CC5 to WL5.
requirements.source_locator: XML anchors cc-maxcap and verifier-result; Table 3 and normative verifier pseudocode

requirements.keyword: none (normative declarative text under the Section 7.1 MUST heading)
requirements.normative_proposition: At an execution-ownership boundary with complete WL3 execution evidence and a claim high enough for the lift, bound provenance raises attainable to WL4 and bound independent verification raises attainable to WL5; neither artifact satisfies the other lift.
requirements.source_locator: XML anchors honesty-boundary, honesty-wl4, and verifier-downgrade; evidence-lift paragraphs and explicit examples

requirements.normative_proposition: Absence of a field or bound artifact required by the claimed level does not by itself cause rejection; the verifier downgrades to the highest level not exceeding the claim whose own evidence requirements are met.
requirements.source_locator: XML anchors fields-conditional and verifier-downgrade; conditional-field list and explicit WL3 example

requirements.normative_proposition: An unknown extension marked critical causes rejection with E_UNKNOWN_CRITICAL_EXTENSION before semantic level evaluation; it must not be ignored or partially accepted.

requirements.normative_proposition: When no recorder qualification or chain applies, verified_level is min(claimed_level, attainable(boundary_type, claimed_level, evidence), maxCapability(effective_cc)); the verdict is accept exactly when verified_level equals the claim and downgrade otherwise.
